semantics.summary: Converts an arithmetic expression to an integer; the 3.5 Chapter 18 example uses INT(RND(1)*5). Rounding of negative fractional inputs remains unverified for 3.5.

printed-pages: Base-manual function definition, printed p. 4-13 (3.0-origin rounding rule only)
notes: Only the one-argument form is demonstrated in 3.5 material. The floor behavior for negative fractional values is documented in the 3.0 base text but is not independently restated in Chapter 18.

support.pending-reason: A partial Rust runtime handler is registered; exact 3.5 reference-interpreter conformance and unverified edge cases remain open.
